feeding_claim.verbatim: Our herds range on pastures of Guinea Grass and a range of clovers.

farmers_markets: Volcano Farmers Market, Cooper Center (Sundays 6am to 9am)
notes: Family ranch in Kau on the Big Island. Beef is sold at The Feed Store in Naalehu (also sells feed and ranch supplies; Mon to Fri 10am to 5pm, Sun 11am to 3pm, call for prices). Homepage stats block shows 100% next to grass-fed beef but does not say how cattle are finished, so category kept at grass-fed. Also sold at Foodland, Sack and Save and Whole Foods stores and a few restaurants. Site mentions GAP Step 4 certification; not checked on the certifier listing so not added. No bulk shares, online ordering or shipping found.
